Pod detail: container port 5050/TCP, PORT=5050, Ready=False, Restart Count=0, Liveness grpc <pod>:5050, Readiness grpc <pod>:5051; events show 'Warning Unhealthy 10s (x9 over 80s) kubelet  Readiness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.2.125:5051" within 1s: context deadline exceeded'. Deployment YAML confirms readinessProbe grpc port 5051 while the container only declares containerPort 5050, so the readiness probe can never succeed while liveness on 5050 stays healthy (no liveness Unhealthy, no 137/143 last-termination state). Consequence: Ready=False and ContainersReady=False, endpoints for Service checkoutservice are empty ('NAME checkoutservice ENDPOINTS <none>'), which produces the caller-side symptom in frontend error logs: 'failed to complete the order: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: dial tcp 10.68.192.48:5050: connect: connection refused' (16 occurrences on POST /cart/checkout). Ruled out: image already present (non image-pull), ServiceAccount checkoutservice exists, Service selector app=checkoutservice matches and port 5050->targetPort 5050 mapping is correct, scheduling succeeded, and namespace events show no Warning rows.
